description: This file defines the LocalDb class that provides a singleton interface to manage a local SQLite database for an attendance tracking application. It includes methods for initializing the database, creating tables, handling user session data, attendance records, and queued synchronization payloads, along with version management and migration support.

classes.name: LocalDb
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods to initialize and interact with the local SQLite database, including CRUD operations for users, attendance, and pending sync payloads, along with migration support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and opens the database, creating tables and applying migrations if necessary.

methods.name: _createV1
methods.description: Creates all tables for version 1 schema.

methods.name: _migrate
methods.description: Handles database schema migrations between versions.

methods.name: insertUser
methods.description: Inserts or updates the current user in the 'users' table, replacing existing data.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user record, if any.

methods.name: clearUser
methods.description: Removes all user records, effectively logging out.

methods.name: addAttendance
methods.description: Inserts an attendance record for a specific date.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for a given date.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Fetches attendance records within a date range.

methods.name: queuePending
methods.description: Adds a payload to the pending synchronization queue.

methods.name: getPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending sync payloads in order.

methods.name: clearPending
methods.description: Clears all entries from the pending sync queue.
